notes: multi-agent analysis: tournament ranking; no pairwise/Elo tournament pattern exists in the catalog, closest are weighted-scoring and multi-criteria-decision but neither runs head-to-head matches

task: After each simulated wet-lab experiment fails, the digital-lab agent writes down in natural language what went wrong and uses that lesson on its next attempt.

Long-running wet-lab simulation jobs must be queued and picked up asynchronously by worker agents instead of blocking the caller.
The digital-lab agent must recall which hypotheses and experiments were already tried in earlier sessions before planning the next one.
notes: multi-agent analysis: context memory across sessions

task: Before finalizing a drone flight plan, ground every routing decision in the exact aviation regulation and airspace-restriction text that applies to the route.
Produce a complete waypoint-by-waypoint drone flight plan as a dependency graph before any step executes, instead of re-prompting after each waypoint.
Score each candidate drone flight path by combining weather, airspace congestion and equipment-failure likelihood into one risk number before selecting a route.
Continuously watch live telemetry from an in-flight drone on a dashboard and only page a human operator when a metric crosses a threshold.
If the primary drone flight-planning model fails or times out, fall back to a simpler deterministic planner so the drone is never left without a plan.
notes: drone: failsafe/fallback; no dedicated graceful-degradation or fallback-planner pattern exists, closest are predictive-agent-fault-tolerance and self-healing-operations-loop but neither describes degrading to a simpler method
